query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN categoryId IS NOT NULL AND subcategoryId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_both,
  SUM(CASE WHEN categoryId IS NOT NULL AND subcategoryId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cat_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN categoryId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_category
FROM blog_posts WHERE status='published';
